chat.title: Chat
chat.greeting: Hello. I can help with writing, summaries and questions.
chat.empty: Bring a question, a document, or an idea. Your assistant will help you take the next step.
chat.placeholder: Ask a question or describe what you need…

chat.hint: Enter to send. Shift+Enter for a new line.

chat.eyebrow: A little help. A lot more possibility.
chat.privateNote: Conversations are private unless you share them.
chat.researchOn: Research mode is on. The reply will cite sources.
chat.toolFailure: A tool call failed and was not recovered.

memory.title: Memory
memory.body: Things the assistant should keep. Say it in chat, or write it here. You can delete any of it.
memory.empty: Nothing is remembered yet. Tell the assistant what to keep, or add a memory here.
memory.enabled: Remember what I tell the assistant
memory.forgotten: All of your memories were deleted.
memory.teamEmpty: This team has no shared memories.
memory.reviewBody: Lessons everyone using this agent should follow. New ones wait until you approve them.
memory.orgBody: After each answer, a model reads what the person said and decides what is worth keeping. These settings apply to every person and every assistant.
memory.orgExtractionHint: When this is off, the assistant keeps only what a person asks it to keep or writes on this page.
memory.orgInstructions: What to keep and what to leave out
memory.orgInstructionsHint: Added to the built-in guidance. For example: Never keep anything about salaries. Up to 2,000 characters.
memory.orgSaved: Saved. It applies from the next answer.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.body: Give your assistants a shared library of documents and sources to draw from.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.empty: No collections yet. Create one and add a document.
knowledge.closest: These are the closest passages. No rerank model is set, so they are not scored against the question.

models.title: Models
models.body: Connect the model providers your organisation uses, add their models, and choose which model the product uses for each kind of work.
models.readOnly: You can see the models here. Changing them needs the permission to manage models.
models.usesBody: Agents, knowledge and memory ask for a model by these names. Point each name at a model you added below.

reasoning.title: Answers
reasoning.body: Every agent answers with this model.

fast.title: Background work
fast.body: Short work after a turn, such as deciding what to remember. Agents use the answers model when this is not set.

vision.title: Images
vision.body: The image tool reads pictures with this model. Choose a chat model marked as able to read images.

embed.title: Search by meaning
embed.body: Knowledge and memory need this to store anything.

rerank.title: Ranking results
rerank.body: Scores search results against the question. Without it the closest passages are shown unscored.

models.noModelOfKind: No {kind} model yet. Add one below.
models.clearBody: The product will have no model for this work until you choose one again.
models.providersBody: A provider is an address that serves models, with the key to use it. Add each model you want to use under its provider.
models.empty: No provider yet. Add the address and key of a model provider to begin.
models.name: Name
models.urlHint: The address of an OpenAI-compatible API, up to and including its version path.
models.apiKeyHint: Stored as a secret. It is not shown again.
models.replaceKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
models.removeProviderBody: A provider can be removed once it has no models.
models.removeModelBody: A model can be removed once nothing uses it.
models.removeAliasBody: An alias can be removed once no published agent names it.
models.upstreamHint: The model's id exactly as the provider names it.
models.modelNameHint: What people see here. Leave empty to use the model id.
models.modelGone: The model is no longer registered

needs.vision: No chat model is marked as able to read images yet.

models.canReadImagesHint: The image tool only uses a model marked this way.

kindHint.embedding: Turns text into numbers so it can be searched by meaning.
kindHint.rerank: Scores how well a passage answers a question.

models.priceHint: In the tenant currency. Usage and quotas price every model call with these numbers. Leave empty to track tokens only.
models.dimensionsHint: Leave empty to take the model's own length. Set it only for a model that can shorten its vectors.
models.rerankPathHint: Under the provider's address, or a full URL. The usual path is /rerank.
models.rerankBodyHint: How the provider wants the request shaped.
models.rerankFloorHint: From 0 to 1. A passage scored under it does not answer the question. Each model scores on its own scale; 0.2 suits most.
models.aliasesBody: Names of your own that an agent can ask for, beside the ones the product uses.
models.aliasNameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.
models.temperatureHint: How varied the answers are, from 0 to 2. Sent when the agent gives no value.

soon.body: This section arrives in a later milestone. Chat, agents, models and users are ready now.

agents.title: Agents
agents.body: Find the right assistant for the work ahead. Each one brings its own instructions, tools, and knowledge.

agents.instructionPlaceholder: Create an agent that reads incoming support tickets and drafts a reply
agents.editorBody: Edit the instructions, choose tools and limits, then publish.
agents.name: Name

agents.noPeers: Publish another agent before this one can call it.
agents.generalHelp: Turn each tool on for this agent. Limits apply to code, shell, fetch and HTTP.
agents.attachHelp: Attach a whole source, or pick individual tools. Tools marked Asks first wait for approval.
agents.connectorToolsHelp: Turn on the tools from a connector you installed. Writes ask for approval.
agents.dataHelp: Read-only SQL on a named connection. Limits apply to Query a database.
agents.outputSchemaHelp: When set, the agent must return JSON matching this schema. Invalid JSON is retried once.
agents.allowHosts: Extra hosts this agent may fetch
agents.createForm: Or fill in the agent yourself

agents.exposeConsoleHelp: Sends through the public API, using the key above.

agents.subagentsHelp: One subagent slug per line. Depth and parallel limits apply when this agent delegates.
agents.tabInstructionsHelp: The instructions above are what the agent follows.

agents.createHint: Describe the work. Build an agent.
agents.createBody: Turn a task you do often into an assistant you can work with.

tools.body: Connect a system in a sentence, then confirm what it is allowed to do.
tools.name: Name

masking.title: Personal data in tool results
masking.body: Before a tool's result reaches the model, the kinds of personal data you choose are replaced with a label such as [EMAIL_ADDRESS]. Ordinary numbers, dates, names and places are left as they are unless you add them.
masking.error: The masking settings could not be loaded.
masking.enabled: Mask personal data in tool results.
masking.enabledHint: When this is off, tool results reach the model as they are.
masking.summaryDefault: {count, plural, one {# kind is} other {# kinds are}} masked: the product default. Switch to Advanced to choose them.
masking.summaryChosen: {count, plural, one {# kind is} other {# kinds are}} masked: your organisation's own list. Switch to Advanced to change it.

sourceHint.format: Found by a pattern, a checksum, or a word nearby that names it, such as “passport”.
sourceHint.language: Found by a language model reading the sentence. These are common in ordinary text and are wrong more often, so a result can lose facts it needs.

masking.score: How sure a match must be
masking.scoreHint: From 0 to 1. The default is {value}: a number is masked only when its format is exact or a word nearby says what it is. A lower value masks more and changes more ordinary numbers.
masking.saved: Saved. It applies to the next tool result.
masking.readOnly: Changing this needs the permission to manage the organisation.

webAccess.body: The hosts your organisation's tools may reach when they fetch a page, call an API or run a command that names a web address. A host that is not listed is refused before anything is sent. An agent can be limited to fewer of these hosts, never to more.
webAccess.loading: Loading the hosts tools may reach
webAccess.error: The list of hosts could not be loaded.
webAccess.empty: No host is listed, so tools cannot reach the web.
webAccess.hostHint: A host name with no address or path. Start it with *. to allow every host under it.
webAccess.added: {host} can now be reached. It applies to the next tool call.
webAccess.readOnly: Changing this needs the permission to manage the organisation.
